schema.workflows:
CREATE TABLE workflows (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project_id TEXT NOT NULL, slot INTEGER NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL,
                root_task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)
schema.attempts:
CREATE TABLE attempts (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, workflow_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflows(id),
                task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id), instance_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES instances(id),
                state TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL)
schema.reservations:
CREATE TABLE reservations (
                attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES attempts(id),
                model_reserved INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(model_reserved>=0),
                tool_reserved INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(tool_reserved>=0),
                model_spent INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(model_spent>=0),
                tool_spent INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(tool_spent>=0),
                verification INTEGER NOT NULL, uncertain INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
schema.model_calls:
CREATE TABLE model_calls (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, attempt_id TEXT REFERENCES attempts(id),
                endpoint_ref TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL)
schema.tool_calls:
CREATE TABLE tool_calls (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES attempts(id),
                state TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL)
schema.integrations:
CREATE TABLE integrations (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, workflow_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflows(id),
                attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES attempts(id), state TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL)
schema.pipeline_receipts: CREATE TABLE pipeline_receipts (pipeline_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pipelines(id), stage TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(pipeline_id,stage))
schema.verification_reservations:
CREATE TABLE verification_reservations (
                        execution_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES verification_executions(id),
                        workflow_id TEXT REFERENCES workflows(id),
                        tool_reserved INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(tool_reserved>=0),
                        tool_spent INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(tool_spent>=0),
                        uncertain INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(uncertain IN (0,1)))

limits: Trusted Python APIs take complete immutable profile snapshots; no new public HTTP/CLI/agent authority. New public adapters must resolve profiles server-side and always supply complete pins.

Current registered profile/project is inspected outside SQL. Final SQL repeats full record/head/project comparison before recipe/task/binding/event/ID writes; no physical inspection or inference under transaction.

Exact replay returns an existing receipt despite later profile supersession; it does not issue a new assignment. Profile selection hashes participate only when pins are supplied, preserving legacy omitted-field request and saved recipe/history hashes.
New branch pins use request-local new:N before server IDs exist; Branching still enforces shared writer/reviewer contract and explicit owner permissions/budget.
The complete pinned route uses real native subprocesses and registered pytest with deterministic English-objective HTTP model responses; it is not a live LM quality experiment.
Other cases deliberately stop at parent wait or alter metadata. Only the complete route is reported succeeded/reserve-free.
